name: Otter
how_to_stop: On the Otter home page open the Meetings tab, then AI Notetaker settings, and choose Meetings I manually select.

name: Fireflies
shown_as: Fireflies Notetaker
how_to_stop: For one call, open Upcoming, find the event under Upcoming Meetings and turn it off there. If Fred is also on the calendar guest list, ask the organizer to remove the invite.

name: Read AI
how_to_stop: Go to Account Settings → Meeting Recording → Auto-Join Preferences. Turn off Auto-Join Calendar Events and Auto-Join Unscheduled Meetings if you want both disabled.

name: Fathom
how_to_stop: In Fathom 3.0, check Auto-capture for the relevant meeting type. Choose Off - capture manually where available if you want to decide each time.

name: tl;dv
how_to_stop: Sign in to tl;dv and open Preferences under personal settings. Switch off automatic recording for the meeting types you want to exclude.

name: Zoom meeting summary
how_to_stop: For yourself: Zoom Settings → Zoom AI → under Meeting, switch Meeting summary with AI off, or untick Auto-start when meetings start.

name: Google Meet "Take notes for me"
how_to_stop: On the calendar event open Video call options → Meeting records and untick Take notes with Gemini.

name: Fellow
how_to_stop: In Fellow open User Settings, go to the Note Taker tab and choose Only meetings I manually toggle.

name: Avoma
shown_as: Avoma Assistant
how_to_stop: In Avoma open Upcoming Meetings, choose the meeting, click its recording label and choose Disable Cloud Recording or the equivalent shown for your meeting app.

name: MeetGeek
shown_as: its owner's name, then “MeetGeek Notetaker”
how_to_stop: To skip one call, open Upcoming Meetings in MeetGeek and turn off the recording toggle beside that event.

name: Gong
shown_as: Gong recorder
how_to_stop: The Gong user marks the calendar event private, at least two hours before it starts.

name: Zoom AI in Google Meet and Teams calls
how_to_stop: For yourself: in Zoom go to Profile → Settings → the Zoom AI tab → Meeting, and switch Allow Zoom AI to join third-party meetings off.

name: Microsoft Teams Copilot
how_to_stop: The organiser opens the meeting's options and sets Copilot to Off. That also turns off recording and transcription for the meeting.

name: Sembly
how_to_stop: For one meeting: in Sembly, find the meeting and switch Attend off. This works only before the call starts.

name: Spinach
how_to_stop: To skip one meeting, open Schedule and turn Spinach off for that event. To remove it from all scheduled meetings, open Auto Record and choose Remove from all meetings.

name: Supernormal
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: Open the Supernormal menu from its desktop icon, choose Preferences, and clear Capture Meetings Automatically.

name: Calendly Notetaker
how_to_stop: For one meeting: on Calendly's Calendar page, find the meeting and switch Notetaker off with the toggle on its right.

name: Bubbles
shown_as: Bubbles Notetaker
how_to_stop: Log in to Bubbles, open Settings, then Notetaker settings, switch Auto-record meetings off and click Save.

name: HubSpot Notetaker
shown_as: the company's name, then “Notetaker”
how_to_stop: For all your meetings: in HubSpot open Settings → General → the Calendar tab, untick Notetaker auto-join and click Save.

name: Notta
how_to_stop: For one meeting, open Upcoming events in Notta and switch Auto-join off beside the event.

name: Webex AI Assistant
how_to_stop: Open the gear in the AI Assistant panel and check Start and stop summary. The host or cohost can keep control or let anyone on the call use it.

name: Fyxer
how_to_stop: In Fyxer open Dashboard → Notetaker → Notetaker settings (the gear at the top right). Under Automatically join, choose None.

name: ClickUp AI Notetaker
how_to_stop: Open the meeting in ClickUp’s Planner or Calendar Glance. For a Personal Notetaker, choose No Notetaker. For a recurring event, check whether you want This event or All events before saving.

name: Grain
how_to_stop: To stop automatic capture, open My Meetings and clear Auto-capture my meetings. To exclude a category of calls, set that category to Don’t capture.

name: monday.com AI Notetaker
shown_as: monday Notetaker
how_to_stop: For one meeting: on the AI Notetaker page in monday.com, find the meeting under Upcoming and switch it off with the toggle.

name: Slack AI huddle notes
how_to_stop: On Slack desktop, open the channel, click its name, and choose Settings. Beside AI huddle notes, click Edit and clear the checkbox that starts notes for every huddle in that channel.

name: Dialpad AI in meetings
how_to_stop: To stop it starting by itself, open Settings on the Dialpad Meetings dashboard and clear Automatically start AI for meetings.

name: Coworker Recorder
how_to_stop: On the Meetings page, open the settings gear and turn off Internal meetings or External meetings according to which calls should stay unrecorded.

name: Granola
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: On desktop, use the stop button at the bottom of the meeting note. Stop between back-to-back calls so the next one starts with a separate note. Granola warns that a call app can leave the microphone active between meetings.

name: Jamie
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: Use the recorder widget to stop. If you expanded Jamie to the full meeting view, use the red Stop button in the bottom recorder bar.

name: Krisp
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
shown_as: Krisp Bot
how_to_stop: For desktop capture, switch Note Taker off in Krisp before joining and leave it off for that call.

name: Notion AI Meeting Notes
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: In the meeting notes block, press Stop. To resume later, open the slider icon on that block and choose Resume transcription.

name: Tactiq
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: In Settings → General, paid users can enable Always ask about transcribing and choose No at the start of a meeting they want to skip.

name: Timeless
how_to_stop: In Timeless open Preferences → Virtual Meetings and select I'll add it manually. This changes what your account sends to future calls. It still lets you add the notetaker yourself when everyone expects it.

name: Wudpecker
how_to_stop: In Settings → Notetaker default joining rules, choose None. On the Plus and Pro plans, this keeps the bot out unless a user deliberately sends it.

name: Circleback
how_to_stop: In Settings → Calendar → Joining preferences, switch off Internal and External to disable automatic bot joins. A personal email account shows All meetings for the internal option.

name: Claap
shown_as: its owner's name, then “Claap Recorder”
how_to_stop: Open Settings from the workspace name, then Meeting preferences → Automation preferences. Choose None under Auto-record the following meetings in my calendar to switch off automatic calendar bot joins.

name: Coffee
how_to_stop: To stop the Coffee bot across your calendar, click the gear → Call Recorder → Which meetings should be recorded? and choose Record no meetings.

name: Sybill
how_to_stop: For one upcoming call, open Meetings and switch off Record in the Meeting Recording panel. Ask the other Sybill users on the invitation to check the same event.

name: Noota
how_to_stop: For automatic bot joining, click your name → Settings → General Settings → Meeting Assistant and set Join meetings automatically to No.

name: Metaview
shown_as: the inviting company's name, then “Metaview Notetaker”
how_to_stop: On the Metaview home page, find the event in My Conversations → Upcoming Conversations. Open the three-dot menu and select Don't capture. Check for the Won’t join tag.

name: Clovers
how_to_stop: Reply to the recruiter with the interview date and ask them to confirm whether audio, video or a transcript will be captured.

name: Leexi
how_to_stop: In Leexi's settings choose which kinds of meeting the assistant joins. For a one-off exception, find the upcoming call on Leexi's home page and switch recording off for that event.

name: Jiminny
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: To leave out a short segment, the person running Jiminny can pause the desktop app. The resulting video contains a black, silent stretch for that interval.

name: Attio call recorder
how_to_stop: To turn off automatic requests from your own calendar, use Account settings. A colleague attending the same call can still bring the recorder with their own settings.

name: Modjo
shown_as: Modjo Assistant (the company can rename it)
how_to_stop: For a single event, open the meeting in the Modjo calendar and choose Cancel scheduled recording.

name: Attention
how_to_stop: To skip a calendar event, open Home and uncheck Join for that event. For an entire customer domain, an admin can use Blocked domains to block automatic joins; a user can still invite the bot manually.

name: Vitally Meeting Recorder
how_to_stop: An administrator can make Manual the default so users choose whether to record each meeting.

name: Jump
how_to_stop: When your firm lets users choose, turn the notetaker off on the specific calendar event. To change your own default in Jump, open Profile & settings → User settings → Preferences → Calendars and switch off Automatically add notetaker to upcoming meetings.

name: BrightHire
shown_as: BrightHire Notetaker
how_to_stop: Open the candidate email or calendar invitation and look for BrightHire's opt-out link. If you have several interview invitations, ask the recruiter to confirm which sessions are affected before the first call.

name: Ashby AI Notetaker
how_to_stop: If you are the candidate, open the recording disclosure link in the calendar invite and select Opt Out. Ashby turns off its notetaker for the candidate's scheduled and future interviews. The same link lets the candidate opt back in.

name: Greenhouse Notetaker
shown_as: Greenhouse Notetaker, then the interview's start time
how_to_stop: Withdraw your consent. Greenhouse sends candidates a link to a consent page that stays open until the application is closed; change your answer there, or tell the recruiter.

name: Dover AI Notetaker
shown_as: Dover Notetaker
how_to_stop: Dover recommends telling the candidate before admitting the notetaker. If the candidate asks to skip recording, check the event's access type before sending them the link.

name: Kula AI Notetaker
how_to_stop: Reply to the recruiter with the time and role and ask them to turn off Notetaker for that interview. Kula directs the recruiter to handle the change on the event.

name: GReminders Notetaker
how_to_stop: From My Events, open the upcoming appointment and turn off its Notetaker switch. If two advisers from the same firm are attending, GReminders applies that change to the other internal participants with the same setting.

name: Google Meet transcripts
how_to_stop: On a computer, open Meeting tools → Transcribing → Stop transcription, then confirm with Stop.

name: Google Meet recording
how_to_stop: On a computer, open Meeting tools → Recording → Stop recording, then confirm in the dialog. On Android, open Tools, tap Record, then Stop.

name: Teams Facilitator
how_to_stop: When scheduling a call, review the Facilitator option and leave it off for a meeting that should run without automated notes.

name: Teams recording and transcription
how_to_stop: Open More actions in the meeting controls. Choose Recording to stop video and live transcription together, or choose Transcribing to stop only the live transcript.

name: Outreach Kaia
shown_as: Kaia (the company can rename it on Zoom and Teams)
how_to_stop: Ask the Outreach user whether the company uses Kaia’s consent page. When it does, the invite link is replaced with a Kaia link. The original meeting link gives you a way to recognize when that wrapping has not happened.

name: BuildBetter
shown_as: BuildBetter, or a name the company chose
how_to_stop: On BuildBetter’s Home page, find the meeting card and turn off Record call. For a recurring meeting, check whether the prompt applies your change to the current occurrence or every future occurrence.

name: Bluedot
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
shown_as: [owner's name]'s AI NoteTaker, when it sends its bot
how_to_stop: For recording from a computer, ask the owner to check auto-record in both the browser extension and desktop app they use.

name: Pipedrive Nova AI Notetaker
how_to_stop: In Settings → Meeting Notetaker → Choose how it joins, choose Manually invite notetaker to stop automatic calendar joins.

name: meetergo notetaker
how_to_stop: Its user switches off Record my meetings under AI Notes → Settings, or switches it off for one meeting.

name: Zoom recording
how_to_stop: The host or co-host can open Record and choose Pause recording for a short break or Stop recording to finish. For a private discussion, wait until the host confirms the pause before speaking.

name: Zoom meeting transcripts
how_to_stop: For a meeting that should have no saved in-meeting transcript, have the host check transcript availability before people begin speaking. A company administrator can set the default for every meeting.

name: ChatGPT Record
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: On the recorder's Mac, select the Stop icon to halt audio capture. From the next screen, choose Resume to continue that same recording or Send to upload the transcript and summary.

name: Productive Notetaker
shown_as: Productive Notetaker
how_to_stop: Before the meeting starts, its user switches the Notetaker toggle off for that meeting, and the bot is removed from it.

name: AudioCodes Meeting Insights (Mia)
shown_as: a name set by the company, often “[first name] Meeting Assistant”
how_to_stop: If you are the meeting owner or a co-organizer, open the Meeting Insights side panel. For a scheduled recording, the toolbar's Stop Recording control pauses Mia and the resume control starts it again.

name: Motion AI Notetaker
how_to_stop: In Motion's conference settings, switch off Turn on AI Notetaker for all meetings with conferencing to change the default. For one sensitive call, turn off the option on that event instead.

name: Speak AI Meeting Assistant
how_to_stop: For one meeting, open Upcoming and switch Record off on the matching event. Confirm the calendar time before changing it when several calls have the same title.

name: AskElephant
how_to_stop: Its user chooses no meetings under Preferences → Notetaker Settings, or marks a meeting as not recorded.

name: Rev Notetaker
how_to_stop: In Meeting Hub, choose Meetings I manually select to have Rev join only when you switch on Add Rev. Leave that switch off for a one-time meeting you want to skip.

name: A bot built on Recall.ai
shown_as: “Meeting Notetaker”, unless the product that sent it chose another name
how_to_stop: Ask who invited it. Each bot is made for one meeting by one product, so somebody in the call — or the organiser's calendar — brought it.

name: Ask Gemini in Google Meet
how_to_stop: Open the Calendar event's meeting options to turn Ask Gemini off before a call. During a call, the host or co-host can use the Gemini menu or the Gemini setting under Host controls.

name: Zoom Revenue Accelerator
shown_as: Zoom Recorder, on Teams and Google Meet
how_to_stop: For an ongoing customer relationship, ask the company using Zoom Revenue Accelerator to check the external participant exclusion for your email domain. If meetings use a phone number, ask them to check that number too.

name: A bot built on MeetingBaaS
shown_as: whatever name the product that sent it typed in
how_to_stop: Ask who invited the recorder before admitting a named guest. Meeting BaaS lets app developers choose the displayed name, so the label may not identify the product.

name: A bot built on Skribby
shown_as: a display name chosen by the app that sent it
how_to_stop: If the bot is in the lobby, have the host identify the requester before admitting it.

name: A bot built on Nylas Notetaker
shown_as: “Nylas Notetaker”, unless the product that sent it renamed it
how_to_stop: Ask the host which app invited the bot. If it already joined, check chat for the recording notice. The product can write its own message and may identify itself there.

name: A bot built on Vexa
shown_as: “Vexa”, unless whoever runs it chose another name
how_to_stop: Don't admit it. Leave it in the lobby, or deny it, until somebody says it is theirs.

name: A bot built on Attendee
shown_as: any name — Attendee has no default; whoever sends it must type one
how_to_stop: Keep the guest in the lobby until someone can identify which app sent it. Since Attendee is self-hostable and the sender chooses the name, the organizer may need to ask each teammate what they have connected to their calendar.

name: ScreenApp Notetaker
shown_as: “<their name>'s Notetaker”
how_to_stop: If you see a lobby guest named after a participant followed by Notetaker, ask that person whether it matches the name in their ScreenApp account.

name: Intelligent recap in Microsoft Teams
how_to_stop: For ordinary intelligent recap, check whether transcription is on. For a meeting using Copilot without transcript retention, also check the organizer’s separate recap option in Meeting options.

name: Zoom AI meeting questions
how_to_stop: If you host the call, open the AI controls and switch off Meeting Questions. Review Meeting Summary too if the request is to stop both features.

name: Zoom My Notes
kind: records on its owner's computer, not in the call
how_to_stop: Open My Notes and use Pause to stop transcribing part of a conversation. Use Resume to continue in the same note, or Done and Complete to finish it.

name: Livestorm recording and transcripts
how_to_stop: Before the event starts, open Settings → Recording & on-demand and turn off Automatically record upon event start. Check the change before opening a live session you intend to keep unrecorded.

name: Zia keynotes in Zoho Meeting
how_to_stop: If you are the presenter, use Pause recording to skip a section of the conversation or Stop recording to finish. Agree with the attendees before you choose Resume recording.

name: Lark AI Notes
how_to_stop: Use AI summary in the toolbar, or hover over the AI summarizing indicator and choose Turn Off. If the organizer limited the controls, ask them to make the change.

name: GoTo Meeting recording and transcripts
how_to_stop: An organizer or co-organizer selects Record again to pause or stop the meeting recording. Pause before a private section and use the indicator to confirm the change.

name: Webex meeting recording
how_to_stop: Before the call, ask the person scheduling it to check automatic recording. If the host is absent, a cohost who assumes the host role can operate the recorder.
